stories.title: Tanishq launches Diwali campaign for international markets
stories.summary: Tanishq has launched its 2026 Diwali campaign, Share the Light, across the US, Singapore and GCC markets. Conceptualised by TBWA\Lintas, the campaign targets Indians living abroad by focusing on how they maintain cultural traditions while building connections in their adopted homes. The festival now includes international logistics.

Tanishq expands Diwali campaign to US, Singapore and GCC
stories.summary: Tanishq is running its 2026 Diwali campaign, Share the Light, in the US, Singapore and GCC markets. Conceptualised by TBWA\Lintas, the campaign explores how Indians living abroad preserve familiar customs while making room for new relationships. Traditions are apparently finding ways to travel across borders.

stories.title: Make My Trip launches campaign with Alia Bhatt and Ranveer Singh
stories.summary: Make My Trip has launched a new campaign titled Ab Toh Jaana Padega, featuring Alia Bhatt and Ranveer Singh. The initiative includes six films designed to inspire year-end holiday planning by showcasing various booking options for flights and accommodations. The company partners with thousands of properties and airlines.

stories.title: Kareena Kapoor Khan fronts Organic Tattva campaign
stories.summary: Organic Tattva has released a digital film featuring Kareena Kapoor Khan to promote its organic sourcing. The brand highlights testing for more than 250 pesticides and offers customers access to product test reports via QR codes on packaging. The campaign carries the line, Because nothing beats the taste of home.

stories.title: Vedang Raina named Tommy Hilfiger India brand ambassador
stories.summary: Tommy Hilfiger has appointed actor Vedang Raina as its India brand ambassador for the Fall Winter 2026 watch collection. The company says Raina brings a contemporary perspective to the campaign, reflecting the brand's style among a new generation of consumers. The collection features American-inspired contemporary designs.

stories.title: WPP to pilot Meta creative solution
stories.summary: WPP will become the first advertising partner to pilot a new creative solution from Meta. The tool is designed to navigate creative strategy and optimisation. This follows a $400 million deal between WPP and Google to contribute to WPP's Open platform. The days of frenemies have evolved.

stories.title: Children’s Day evolves into marketing moment
stories.summary: Children’s Day, observed annually on November 14, commemorates the birth of India’s first Prime Minister. While traditionally marked by school assemblies, the occasion has evolved into a distinct creative moment for the country’s advertising and marketing ecosystem. Brands now use the day to highlight curiosity and childhood.

stories.title: Brands shift to storytelling in recent campaigns
stories.summary: Brands including JK Super Cement, NIVEA and Tanishq are using storytelling and cultural narratives to build connections with consumers. Advertising is moving beyond product-focused messaging to explore emotions and everyday experiences. The campaigns span sectors from construction and jewellery to personal care and banking.

stories.title: Children’s Day advertising shifts to social media
stories.summary: Children’s Day advertising in India has moved from catchy jingles on national television to fragmented, hyper-targeted social media content. Brands are increasingly collaborating with influencers to address relatable parenting challenges. The era of the universally memorised TV commercial has been largely replaced by the social media reel.

stories.title: Brands use storytelling for holiday campaigns
stories.summary: Brands are using storytelling to emphasise themes of celebration and generosity for the upcoming festive season. Notable campaigns include OpenAI’s focus on kindness and Google India’s AI-integrated travel film featuring Kareena Kapoor Khan. Luxury brands are also participating in the holiday push.

stories.title: Brand Hall of Fame inducts five new members
stories.summary: The Brand Hall of Fame has inducted Home Depot, ESPN, Disney, Budweiser and Chick-fil-A for 2026. Nominees are measured against 10 criteria for sustained success over decades. Apple also became the first brand honored in The One Club's Creative Hall of Fame. The list continues to grow.

stories.title: Archer Roose Wines discusses brand loyalty
stories.summary: Archer Roose Wines is attempting to disrupt the wine industry by rethinking packaging and brand voice. CEO Marian Leitner-Waldman and chief creative officer Elizabeth Banks discussed their strategy for sustainable growth and challenging conventions in a competitive market. The company focuses on consumer insight to build its brand.

stories.title: Gopuff discusses challenger brand strategy
stories.summary: Gopuff head of marketing Tyler Stewart says the company’s edge lies in proprietary logistics rather than outspending competitors. Speaking at Brandweek 2026, Stewart noted that competitors can also serve as distribution partners. The company aims to be debated rather than ignored in the crowded commerce space.

stories.title: Indian brands move toward direct agency appointments
stories.summary: A growing number of Indian advertisers are bypassing traditional multi-agency pitches to appoint agencies directly. WPP CEO Cindy Rose recently criticised the practice as a CEO handshake thing, leading to a public dispute with Publicis Groupe. The trend continues despite opposition from major agency holding companies.

stories.title: Small businesses push back against influencers
stories.summary: Cat cafe owner Nicole Flanagin recently found her business targeted by a local influencer seeking a review. The incident highlights growing friction between small business owners and creators who use their platforms to solicit free goods. Some business owners are now opting to publicly address these unsolicited requests.

stories.title: YouTube hits record US TV viewing share
stories.summary: YouTube reached 15.8% of all US TV viewing time in August 2026, a Nielsen record and more than double Netflix's 7.7%. Hollywood has responded by hiring YouTube executives and moving creator-led films into theaters. Nielsen measures audiences to determine who watches what and for how long.

stories.title: E.l.f. Cosmetics sets Guinness World Record at TwitchCon
stories.summary: E.l.f. Cosmetics and streamer Yonna Jay gathered 733 people at TwitchCon San Diego on November 14 to set a Guinness World Record for the largest simultaneous Get Ready With Me session. Twitch confirmed the record on X, noting the event sold out the convention's largest stage.

stories.title: Twitch reports surge in creator sponsorships
stories.summary: Twitch Chief Product Officer Mike Minton says the number of creators securing brand sponsorships through the platform has quadrupled since last year, with total payouts doubling. Minton noted that while creators are eager for deals, they often struggle to find them without the platform's dedicated sponsorship tools.

stories.title: Influencer talent management commissions shift in India
stories.summary: Influencer talent management agencies in India traditionally charge a 20% commission on brand partnerships. Established creators are now negotiating rates closer to 15% as they increasingly attract advertisers independently. The shift raises questions about the value agencies provide to creators who no longer require assistance with campaign coordination.

stories.title: Creators move from YouTube to cinema screens
stories.summary: Amelia Dimoldenberg is screening the final episodes of her YouTube series Chicken Shop Date in cinemas. The move marks a departure from traditional broadcasting, following a twelve-year run that helped define the creator-led format. The show originally launched in 2014 after being rejected by traditional television networks.

stories.title: AIVANTA builds summit for brand-creator relationships
stories.summary: AIVANTA has launched software that tracks and scores introductions between brands and creators. Founder Donnovan Andrews intends to use the data to support Authentic, a new summit for brands. Andrews cites recent cracks in Google's search business as evidence that brands need new ways to reach audiences.

stories.title: Brands shift toward creator councils
stories.summary: Brands are moving away from one-off influencer campaigns in favor of creator councils. This model involves building standing panels of influencers to foster long-term influence rather than relying on disconnected collaborations. The shift reflects the maturing creator economy and a desire for more consistent brand-creator relationships.

stories.title: Creators demand equity for brand partnerships
stories.summary: Allison Ellsworth, co-founder of Poppi, says creators are now requesting advisory roles and equity before promoting her new hydration brand, Jetty. Ellsworth noted that creators are increasingly seeking ownership stakes after observing the financial success of her previous venture, which was sold to PepsiCo in 2025.

stories.title: YouTube expands clips tool to Shorts
stories.summary: YouTube has expanded its video clips tool to allow creators to convert long-form segments, such as podcast episodes, into vertical Shorts. Each Short will include a clickable link directing viewers to the original source video. The feature was announced following a series of updates to YouTube Studio.

stories.title: YouTube adds AI comment management tools
stories.summary: YouTube has introduced AI-powered tools within YouTube Studio to help creators manage video comments. The system groups related responses by meaning, allowing creators to filter feedback without searching for specific keywords. The platform has relabeled its existing exact-match search field to accommodate the new AI-driven search filter.

stories.title: YouTube Studio updates analytics and mobile tools
stories.summary: YouTube has introduced Insights, a plain-language layer for Analytics, and a new Research tab. Additionally, the Ask Studio conversational assistant is now available on mobile and can process up to 10 uploaded images at once. The updates were detailed on the company's Creator Insider channel.

stories.title: Google introduces shared codes for YouTube ads
stories.summary: Google announced that its Display and Video 360 platform will soon support shared codes for brand partnerships. The code allows a creator to link a video directly to an advertiser's account without requiring manual channel searches or additional approval rounds. The company provided no specific launch date.

stories.title: Twitch to allow external short-form video uploads
stories.summary: Twitch will allow creators to upload short-form videos made outside the platform starting early next year. The move is intended to improve on-platform discovery and increase ad inventory. Executives stated the goal is not to replicate TikTok but to help viewers find creators within the Twitch ecosystem.

stories.title: Lyft tests home screen ad placements
stories.summary: Lyft is alpha testing a home masthead ad unit that gives brands full ownership of the app's home screen before a ride is booked. The company, which saw its ad business grow 100% year over year in 2025, is testing the feature alongside existing sponsored vehicle designs.

stories.title: Twitch debuts shoppable ads
stories.summary: Twitch has unveiled new shoppable and skippable ad products. The additions are intended to help the livestreaming service meet the full-funnel marketing needs of advertisers. The announcement coincided with the platform's annual TwitchCon event.

stories.title: Google Ads adds invalid traffic reporting
stories.summary: Google has introduced an Invalid Traffic Overview Card in Google Ads to show advertisers estimated savings from traffic filtering. The feature consolidates data previously found in separate billing and campaign reports. The card is currently rolling out globally and is also available within Search Ads 360.

stories.title: IAB calls for standardized view counts
stories.summary: The IAB is calling on platforms to standardize how they define a view. The move follows YouTube's recent change to its public view counts, which data from Agentio suggests over-reported actual views by 40%. YouTube previously stated the change was intended to help creators express their value to sponsors.

stories.title: Meta launches AI ad tools with in-chat checkout
stories.summary: Meta announced a suite of AI-powered advertising tools at Advertising Week 2026. The updates include an expanded business assistant capable of accessing historical campaign data, brand voice guidelines, and strategy documents. The company is also testing scheduled tasks that allow the assistant to deliver recurring performance reports automatically.

stories.title: Nectar launches Creator Agent for influencer outreach
stories.summary: Nectar released Creator Agent to automate discovery, outreach, and reporting for Instagram and TikTok campaigns. The product aims to replace spreadsheets and manual messaging with an AI system that finds and vets potential partners. The company notes that human checks remain essential for trust and return on investment.

stories.title: SalesHood brings revenue enablement to AI tools
stories.summary: SalesHood announced SalesHood MCP, a platform that connects approved content and digital sales rooms to AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini. Built on the Model Context Protocol, the service is designed to provide sellers with trusted answers and assets directly within their existing AI interfaces.

stories.title: Basis expands AI advertising intelligence
stories.summary: Basis released a unified intelligence and automation layer powered by its Compass AI. The system integrates historical campaign performance with market research from Morning Consult and Dstillery to assist media teams. The company says the tool helps teams move from strategy to execution through integrated AI-powered workflows.

stories.title: Nectar introduces always-on creator agent
stories.summary: Nectar launched an agentic growth OS powered by its Ren AI. The Creator Agent is designed to find, vet, contact, and report on influencers automatically. The company claims the system replaces weeks of manual scrolling and spreadsheet management by running creator programs on autopilot.

stories.title: Iterable launches hosted MCP server for AI workflows
stories.summary: Iterable announced a hosted Model Context Protocol server, AI-assisted SDKs, and an expanded integrations hub. The company says these tools are designed to scale AI impact across marketing teams. The launch follows previous efforts to connect customer context across the marketing stack for organizational use.

stories.title: Marketers deploying AI agents faster than they can measure them - MarTech
ActiveCampaign adds MCP support to Active Intelligence
stories.summary: ActiveCampaign opened its Active Intelligence platform to external tools via the Model Context Protocol. The update includes prebuilt connectors for services like Google Ads, LinkedIn, and Stripe. The company suggests users can now pull internal data to trigger targeted campaigns without leaving the platform.

stories.title: The gap between data and business decisions
stories.summary: Enterprises often possess significant amounts of data regarding site traffic and spending but struggle to translate these metrics into actionable strategy. Despite years of investment in analytics and marketing clouds, many companies still rely on delayed reports to determine budget splits and customer retention tactics.
